items.body:

hexagon: add support for hadamard MUL_MAT and GET_ROW for flat and tiled Q1_0 and Q2_0 (#30627)

* hex-hadamard: add support for hadamard ops

* hex-mm: reduce pkt counts in the q8_1 quantizer and vec_dot_q1

* hex-q1/q2: add support for flat and tiled GET_ROWS for Q1_0 and Q2_0

---------

Co-authored-by: Max Krasnyansky <maxk@qti.qualcomm.com>

</details>
